question: What letter height does a roadside sign need, derived from vision and motion?
summary: Acuity (5 arcmin letter) + speed x reaction time + offset geometry reproduced the USSC method; design LI 15-30 ft/in vs corpus 30-40; underestimated reaction time (5s vs USSC 9s) and conflated cone of vision with foreshortening angle. Usable framing: letter height scales with word count, so cut words before buying sq ft.
